Name: Joja Immersion Bonus Pack
Author: CopperSun
Description:
This is just a small bonus pack for my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8586]Joja Immersion[/url]. It adds a couple new lines for the kids (Vincent and Jas) depending on the config setting you choose.

It also includes a letter from Sebastian describing his frustration after having a mod of his plagiarized by someone hiding behind 'copyright' (and the legal grey area that all mods exist in) to rules lawyer their way into not only keeping it up on JojaMods but who is also accepting monetary compensation for it in the form of "mod bucks," which are given to JojaMod authors for downloads.

Fortunately, Seb and his family are able to find a 'constructive' way (it's a pun!) to disengage from the online drama and bond as a family instead. Like the original Joja Immersion, this story is told through the letter and dialog with various NPCs, so make sure to talk to everyone! (If you want to spoil yourself, here is the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbxE9myZrsg]delightful video[/url] which they are referencing.)

The letter which triggers the dialog is sent after you have about 4 and a half hearts with Sebastian.
You do not need to do the Joja route to get the letter and related dialog.

[b]Note: [/b]I normally do not opt my mods into the Donation Points system here on Nexus. In this instance, however, I will be opting in and donating all DP to charity (Doctors Without Borders). That said, please do [i]not[/i] tip me if Nexus tries to give you the option. I make mods for free because I like to share my creations, not to try and get a few dollars in my paypal account.
